_readme: S720 lever: Santiago Canyon College's registry row now names SCC_2026_2027_Catalog_accessible.pdf (1,165 pages by pypdf in paid read 45350768246, which refused the run before any extraction), where the pins of S720 named pages of SCC_2026_2027_Catalog.pdf (374 pages, page read 45341735139). This plan prints the accessible file's pages, line for line, so a session re-pins 11909, 21673 and 42990 to their sections there (or files a named gap) before the paid read goes again. One load, no model call, nothing written. The page read prints at most 1,000 PDF pages (PDF_PAGE_CAP_MAX), so the span is pp.166-1165: the old file's credit programs began about a quarter of the way in (CSU GE on p.102 of 374), past p.166 of 1,165 by the same share.
